name: JAMES_SON_OF_ZEBEDEE
canonical: James the son of Zebedee, John's elder brother and a 'son of thunder', a powerfully built Galilean of about thirty-five, broad-shouldered and tall with sun-darkened ruddy-olive skin, a bold square-jawed commanding face with strong dark brows, thick jet-black hair pushed back and a full dense black beard, a firm resolute set to his mouth, dressed in a rust-red mantle over a coarse ochre tunic with a thick leather belt, one strong hand resting at his side. His eyes are ORDINARY natural dark-brown human eyes — NOT glowing, NOT luminous, NOT red, NOT orange, NOT yellow, NOT supernatural in any way; a normal calm human gaze
notes: Pass `anchor` as --image to lock identity/world across scenes.
